title: Saving the Journey discovery layout keeps the outcomes, guarantee, FAQ and guide progress

source.ref: Journey audit 2026-11-17 (project thread: Dial in the Journey Wizard and Journeys)

detail: The Advanced panel's Discovery layout control (components/journey/v2/journey-advanced.tsx) sends only the discovery widgets as bare { id, enabled } rows, and setJourneyPageConfig wrote that array straight to journey_plans.page_config. The story widget's settings carry the authored outcomes, guarantee and FAQ (LIVE-393, LIVE-395) and the reserved wizard row carries the guide's progress (ADR-839), so hiding or reordering one widget silently erased the Journey's sales copy and reset the guide. Fixed 2026-11-17: setJourneyPageConfig reads the stored config and writes mergePageLayout(stored, layout) (lib/journeys/page-layout-merge.ts), which takes only enabled and order from the save, keeps each entry's stored settings, and keeps every stored entry the save did not name. Guarded by lib/journeys/page-layout-merge.test.ts.

verify.note: Fails if setJourneyPageConfig writes the layout without merging it onto the stored page_config, or the merge drops stored settings or unnamed entries.
